title: Rowan Bell · Community Manager · call with Bram Meadowholt · August 2025
notice: Synthetic demo material. Invented document; no real meeting, publication, email or call occurred.

blocks.text: Called to check in on Bram's work with the Timber Verge Community Garden and with Emerycombe Fabrication.

The garden's seed fund tracking was just a small thing. They were keeping notes in a ledger, but it was hard to see a monthly picture. I made a single sheet with columns for date, vendor, purpose, and amount, with a total at the bottom. They fill it in when someone makes a purchase from the fund.
Bram says the garden coordinator told him they've used it for the last three months and it's made their reporting to the neighborhood council much clearer.

The Emerycombe job was different. They had a year's worth of supplier invoices and receipts just piled in a file box. The business license audit notice came, and they needed everything sorted by quarter and by expense type—materials, subcontractor fees, that sort of thing.
Bram says he spent two full days at their workshop, sorting, labeling, and creating a summary index. He says it was mostly grunt work, but it needed doing.
I left them with the organized files and the index. The audit is next week, so they should be able to find anything the inspector asks for.
Bram didn't mention any payment for the garden work; it was volunteer. The Emerycombe job was a paid contract.
